post.text: In 2006 Will Ferrell joined Saturday Night Live musical guests Queens of the Stone Age as his BÖC "Cowbell" character from 6 years earlier. Josh Homme kept laughing during rehearsal, he was told to try to think of Will as a serious musician so he wouldn't break character!😂 https://t.co/x9oVi6cP2B

description.description: A man in an orange jacket with blue trim is on stage during a performance on Saturday Night Live. He appears to be about to start a performance or speech. Behind him, on the left, there is a sign for a shop. The man, Will Ferrell, is being joined on stage by the rock band Queens of the Stone Age. Josh Homme, the band's frontman, is center stage singing and playing guitar. Other band members play alongside him on a brightly lit stage with red and yellow lighting. The performance is being filmed for television, as indicated by the NBC logo in one frame.

tweetMedia.transcription: Ladies and gentlemen, Queens of the Stone Age! I turn around, come together cause I own them. So get ready, I will be there, you better. That old sister can't survive another way. Now I'm living like a high and sad owl. That old sister can't survive another way. Now I'm slipping right behind you The shadow Thank you.
